svg.aria-label: M-Pesa Sorting Desk: Reads M-Pesa SMS receipts on the Mac and lays them out on a shared desk, where each one gets a category, a need-or-want tag and a note. One go-ahead imports the sorted batch into the Loan Portal's expenses.
